answer: The haven register is checked at draw time, sable lists the eligible set, and knoll seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 84 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 84 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. Each impostor pays 13 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
